groups.interpretation: Frozen slotted span record stores physical integer pair, First and confirmation timestamps, normalized top/bottom; not a canonical accepted reaction.
Compute published clone first; convert original reaction First then Break to int, no local fallback on invalid original fields.

Construct span using original physical pair, original First main positional timestamp and confirmation from original reaction with default intrabar flag, then normalize published top then bottom. Publication geometry and confirmation provenance distinct; confirmation may fallback to main open.
Short circuit outer First strictly earlier, confirmation >= inner, top >= inner top, bottom <= inner bottom; equal First excludes; other equalities admit. No path check yet.
Lower left bisect at First, right bisect at confirmation includes all equal boundary times; relies on native ordered index alignment.
Empty or reversed positional interval returns None without price queries.
Query minimum Low then maximum High for same interval; discard index positions and return price pair. Nonempty observed path not proof of complete coverage; failures propagate.
Non-null path guard first, inclusive bottom <= path min then inclusive top >= path max; short circuit, not another time/identity test.
Initialize result/map containers and direction-specific empty blocked-time sets.
Visit bullish then bearish; obtain full result; enumerate zip native reactions and spans from one. Zip truncates to shortest input, no explicit validation.

Sequentially assign metadata number, top, bottom, confirmation time, First time, internal flag by span physical membership to original native reaction. Does not clone or filter full list. Any failure may leave partial metadata mutations.
Keep full result object; identity ordinal map from all reactions, not limited by zipped prefix. Unprocessed tail may keep prior metadata.

Build set of main timestamps from each blocked First index; dedup by timestamp, not physical pair. Return full objects, ordinal maps, original blocked mapping and time sets. Failure propagates without local rollback.
Build all spans before computing blocked ownership, fixed bullish then bearish mapping, preserve each input list order.
All generator checks exact datetime type then tzinfo None, short circuit first false; empty all true. No global monotonicity check; provider supports separate monotone runs.
Visit spans in mapping order, select opposite direction; construct index from caller-order outer triples if eligible, otherwise None (full scan). Provider partitions on either start/end decrease.
Create physical identity set; for each inner reset lazy path extrema to None; use all outer spans on fallback, otherwise enclosing query (strict start/inclusive end), not a final ownership verdict.
Traverse possible owners; full may_contain guard first. Failed candidate continues without lower extrema work.
Compute inner path once on first eligible outer if extrema None; missing path breaks entire owner search for this inner. Nonempty tuple reused for later candidates.
First successful inclusive path containment adds inner physical identity and breaks owner search; set records blocked identity not chosen owner pair. After inner loop assign direction set.
Apply metadata only after both direction blocked sets built and return helper result; no clone/rollback of native full records. Prior confirmation/index caches may already have side effects.

supplemental.historical: Frozen span derives geometry from published clone but confirmation from original reaction with default flag; First time comes from main sequence at converted index. These are distinct provenance sources.

Ordered four-condition containment; strict First, inclusive confirmation and edges. Lower path uses bisect_left First and bisect_right confirmation. Nonempty observed path required, not proof of gap-free coverage; compute min then max. Outer path test uses inclusive bounds.

Fixed bullish then bearish metadata mutation; zip truncates silently on mismatched lists, ordinal map covers entire reaction list, blocked First timestamps set. Full native results retained, not copied or filtered. No mutation rollback in helper.

Build all spans first. Index eligibility exact naive datetimes only, not global time monotonicity: containment constructor partitions caller-order runs. Empty set passes all. Otherwise fallback full opposite scan.

Per inner: traverse possible owners in original-compatible order, reject may_contain false before path compute; compute extrema on first eligible outer, absent path stops search; successful owner adds physical identity and breaks. Apply metadata after both directions complete.

decision_order: published clone before original identity and confirmation
outer strict First before inclusive confirmation and box checks
lower inclusive path, min then max
exact naive datetime index admission versus full scan
lazy inner path after eligible outer; null stops owner search
first successful outer adds blocked physical identity
both directions built before original metadata mutation
limitations: No path coverage, runtime, native caller coherence or accepted cross-owner proof. Batch first-match identity differs from live all-owner pairs; live review next.

findings.meaning: Clarify RE63–RE68 ordered provenance, inclusive path and equality, exact type index eligibility without global ordering, blocked timestamp deduplication, zip tail and partial write boundaries. B02-06-F01–F03 retained.
